steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In October 2021, Equity Mates described Tesserent as providing full-service enterprise-grade cybersecurity and networking to mid-market enterprise and government clients in Australia, delivered by 350+ security engineers and a Cyber 360 offering including ID protection and 24/7 threat monitoring.

episode.title: Our Order Pad  | Tesserent (TNT:ASX) & SVB Financial Group (SIVB:NAS)

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In October 2021, Equity Mates said TNT aimed to build on organic growth targeting high value government work but highlighted moat risks: integration of acquired firms, reliance on a small key management group, increasing domestic and international competition, and reputational damage if clients suffer cybersecurity incidents.

episode.title: Our Order Pad  | Tesserent (TNT:ASX) & SVB Financial Group (SIVB:NAS)

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In October 2021, Equity Mates noted TNT had spent the past two years and $25 million acquiring several smaller businesses as part of a major revamp after listing, indicating a roll-up approach to drive growth.
